mapper.insert: INSERT INTO asset_entity (urn, type, qualifier, display_name, owner, note, update_time) VALUES (#{urn}, #{type}, #{qualifier}, #{displayName}, #{owner}, #{note}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT urn, type, qualifier, display_name AS displayName, owner, note FROM asset_entity WHERE urn = #{urn}
SELECT urn, type, qualifier, display_name AS displayName, owner, note FROM asset_entity ORDER BY urn
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lineage_edge (from_urn, to_urn, source, update_time) VALUES (#{fromUrn}, #{toUrn}, #{source}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT id, from_urn AS fromUrn, to_urn AS toUrn, source FROM lineage_edge WHERE from_urn = #{fromUrn} AND to_urn = #{toUrn} AND source = #{source} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, from_urn AS fromUrn, to_urn AS toUrn, source FROM lineage_edge ORDER BY from_urn, to_urn
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lineage_run (event_key, event_type, job_urn, inputs_json, outputs_json, at_ms, error, update_time) VALUES (#{eventKey}, #{eventType}, #{jobUrn}, #{inputsJson}, #{outputsJson}, #{atMs}, #{error}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT id, event_key AS eventKey, event_type AS eventType, job_urn AS jobUrn FROM lineage_run WHERE event_key = #{eventKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO asset_schema_change (asset_urn, at_ms, field, change, before, after, breaking, update_time) VALUES (#{assetUrn}, #{atMs}, #{field}, #{change}, #{before}, #{after}, #{breaking}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT id, asset_urn AS assetUrn, at_ms AS atMs, field, change, before, after, breaking FROM asset_schema_change WHERE asset_urn = #{assetUrn} ORDER BY at_ms DESC, id DESC
SELECT id, asset_urn AS assetUrn, at_ms AS atMs, field, change, before, after, breaking FROM asset_schema_change ORDER BY at_ms DESC, id DESC
